The '''''Annals of Applied Probability''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[mathematics journal]] published by the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]. The journal was established in 1991 with [[J. Michael Steele]] as founding [[editor-in-chief]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Annals of Applied Probability |url=https://projecteuclid.org/journals/annals-of-applied-probability/scope-and-details |access-date=2022-01-04 |website=projecteuclid.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Editors of IMS Publications |url=https://imstat.org/past-editors-of-ims-journals/|access-date=2022-01-04}}</ref> It is indexed by ''[[Mathematical Reviews]]'', ''[[Zentralblatt MATH]]'', and the [[Science Citation Index Expanded]]. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 1.8.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter=Annals of Applied Probability |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
